200.body: --> --> Poland Expects 5-7 Fold Increase in Belarusian Applications for EU Long-Term Resident Card 29.09.2026 / 11:15 Бел Łac Рус Nashaniva.com Such a forecast is made by the Office for Foreigners (UdSC), writes Most. In 2026-2028, Belarusians will submit 5-7 times more applications in Poland for obtaining EU long-term resident status than in 2022-2025. A surge in the number of applications for EU long-term resident status is predicted here, by approximately 500%, meaning an increase from an average of 500 cases per year to more than 3 thousand proceedings annually. The Office for Foreigners predicts that the mass application process for resident cards "may lead to a shortage of places in examination centers and a delay in the application preparation process." More Applications for Citizenship In parallel, in 2026-2028, according to UdSC forecasts, the number of cases for Belarusians seeking recognition as Polish citizens will increase.

200.body: Hyundai Rotem is operating a 35-member on-site support organization and securing spare repair parts on its own to provide maintenance support until a local MRO system is established. ​Once a tank's warranty expires, Hyundai Rotem's contractual maintenance obligations are limited. Hyundai Rotem has asked the South Korean government to consult with the Polish government to accelerate the execution of Poland's MRO budget and the construction of related facilities. ​The second executive contract signed last year includes local production and technology transfer for the K2 tank. Hyundai Rotem will additionally supply 180 K2 tanks and 81 tanks across three related vehicle types, while some K2PL tanks, the Polish variant of the K2, will be produced locally. Hyundai Rotem is preparing to sign a third executive contract with Poland for K2 tanks.

500.body: Photograph: Rokas Tenys/Alamy Opinion AI (artificial intelligence) As AI models go rogue, do you still trust OpenAI and Anthropic to stop them? 600.body: Volleyball: 2026 Men's European Championships: Poland claims title in Olympic gold-medal rematch with France, securing LA28 quota It's a second straight European title for Poland, denying France across four sets in Milano, Italy. The squad emerged triumphant on Saturday (26 September) in the final of the 2026 Men's European Championships , beating France in what was a rematch of the Paris 2024 Olympic gold-medal game - won by France . The win was a second straight European title (2023) for Poland, and their third overall (2009). "It's not the end; it doesn't mean that we won't fight in every tournament we play in... there's always the chance for us to play for golds." A perennial powerhouse in the sport, the team's silver from Paris 2024 came nearly 50 years after their lone gold medal in men's volleyball - won at Montreal 1976 .
